description: Rokid Glasses AIUI Agent - number catch: aim at a room, locker, pickup or parking number, take a telephoto photo, and the host language model reads the digits from the photo as a data: URL image (the official read-text path - there is no OCR). The read is shown huge for your check and is only stored after you confirm it; dictate or step in a correction first if it is wrong, or enter the number by dictation/stepper alone when the photo path fails. Up to 6 confirmed numbers stay in view while you walk; in the full-screen recall view a two-step nod (or DEL) clears one. Photos are never saved - only the number text you confirmed, on device
name: number-catch
